title: organizational_relation.created event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 20.5/19e.20. Produced by epd2_organization_service.events.build_organizational_relation_created_event. Minimum payload only: the relation's own id, relation_type, its derived relation_category, status, effective_time (the relation's own valid_from), recorded_at, and decision_reference where an authorizing_decision_reference was supplied - never source_organization_id/target_organization_id (those live only on the SubjectRef/audit trail and the full relation_state_payload used for after_hash, not the broadcast wire event).
